svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 663.1B tokens, 94.4% cache hit, $574,873.82 estimated cost, peak 66.8B on 05-22. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
